hooks.name: jakarta-import-guard
hooks.description: From stage 2 on: when the agent saves a Java file that still imports a Jakarta EE API from javax.*, report it back to the agent. Enable this hook in Module 3.

action.command: if grep -nE '^import (static )?javax\.((persistence|validation|servlet|inject|jms|mail|websocket|ejb|faces|el|xml\.bind|xml\.ws|ws\.rs)\.|annotation\.(PostConstruct|PreDestroy|Resource|security\.)|transaction\.[A-Z*])' "{{filePath}}" 1>&2; then echo 'Jakarta EE API still imported from javax.* - migrate it to jakarta.* (JDK packages such as javax.sql or javax.transaction.xa stay).' 1>&2; exit 1; fi
